retainedFunctionalContracts.topic: One-stop entry points, installation, account setup/reset and control/config/application updates
retainedFunctionalContracts.checks: Current command grammar, compatibility checks before stop, fixed pending-journal bootstrap verbs, exact legacy policy ownership, no-op conditions, candidate build/probes and retained recovery; account credentials and homes are preserved.

retainedFunctionalContracts.topic: Root authorization, actual execution identity and project creation
retainedFunctionalContracts.checks: CLI-only rootAllowed policy and revision, native fixed UID versus explicit UID0, separate homes/no credential copies, managed native control capability, transaction restart/recovery, auto path resolving and actual native mkdir/fsync; post-creation uncertainty and UTF-8 output budget.

retainedFunctionalContracts.topic: Transaction journals, retained service definitions and reversible candidate capacity
retainedFunctionalContracts.checks: Trusted recorded bindings and barriers; strict ordinary verify versus exact recorded legacy restoration; shared management lock modes without relaxing initialization; archive complete three-probe evidence, unmounted/stopped proof, capacity eight and no deletion shortcut.

retainedFunctionalContracts.topic: Managed proxy core/configuration/routing and compensating lifecycle
retainedFunctionalContracts.checks: Official immutable core/asset verification, private selection, total network deadlines, per-chain rule order, PID1-maintained cgroup set and fixed worker/gateway/management scope, checked core/config startup, listener readiness and upstream verification; candidate activation/rollback preserve root policy, data, old assets and journals.

Legacy registry migration, multiple connections, disabled-provider credential redaction/protection, Zhipu empty default discovery, official/native/catalog read paths, exact layers and durable receipts with safe unknown/recovery classification.

Current HTTP/DNS/import modes, staging/active certificate transaction, precise trust/SNI/instance checks, cancellation/compensation, pinned Caddy DNS build; backup/restore includes exact instance proxy core root and both optional role barriers. Go pins and unchanged test interiors inherit prior audit, no compilation.

retainedFunctionalContracts.topic: Workspace helper and accepted-result witness boundaries
retainedFunctionalContracts.checks: Actual native identity, root/path restrictions, serialized helper receipts, before-send ownership, durable positive receipt, acknowledgement cleanup after caller proof, retained unknown effects and no resend after helper success.

freshConclusions: Auto project paths remain POSIX/actual-identity checked with fixed effective home, no arbitrary parent creation, mkdir/fsync durability and bounded UTF-8 acknowledgement; the new runtime repairs do not change this helper contract.

Root authorization stays CLI-only and ordinary execution-chain guarded; effective native/root identity and independent homes remain bound to revision and capabilities. No deployment operation implicitly enables rootAllowed or copies user credentials.

Managed proxy remains isolated to the instance worker/gateway/management cgroups, verifies exact rule ordering and member names, checks full network deadlines, and preserves the existing root policy while publishing only serviceProxy selection through a retained compensating transaction.

Application activation still verifies releases/account compatibility, records stop/select/commit phases, restores old selection on failed startup, and never compensates after a terminal record publication. Control generation capabilities preserve managed execution and proxy support.

Candidate archive retains exact successful probe/release/inode evidence and original stopped service state; current known-idle checks reject unknown activity, including the new resume uncertainty state. No candidate cleanup or recovery shortcut was added.

Fixed control material includes the current project/helper, execution and proxy capabilities, without cached bytecode or unrelated files. Current unit markers still select the actual authorized native/root identity.
crossScopeAckReview: thread/resume now records accepted immediately after workflowMutation succeeds, before SessionSnapshots.capture and continuation readback. Later generic/default-not_sent failures become unknown and set the actual thread uncertainty; original unknown and true pre-positive rejection remain intact.

Worker RPC records callResolved only after service.call fulfills. Reply serialization failure then reports unknown while retaining original error code/message/data; no resumed input or call retry is introduced.

Read-only regression review includes the real256KiB snapshot-budget overflow using a schema-valid resume result and no second resume dispatch, success/continuation/pre-write controls, plus controlled completed-call serialization fixtures. These are existing author runs, not newly executed tests.

Round5-to-round6 full-manifest comparison shows exactly main.ts/service.ts and their two existing tests changed, with no deployment file changes. The native helper durable-positive/unknown contract and fixed native status identity remain compatible.
